problem: Delayed B2B payments and receivables collection
who_is_affected: B2B-selling manufacturers, distributors and service firms
msmes_affected: ~1-1.5 crore B2B sellers; most acute for 8-12 lakh firms of Rs 2-250 cr turnover
financial_impact_evidence: Rs 7.34 lakh cr delayed (Mar-24, GAME 3.0) / ~Rs 8.1 lakh cr (Economic Survey 2025-26); avg payment 73 days vs 45-day law; 82.6% of invoices carry 0-30 day terms (Recordent 2026); only Rs 55,244 cr (~7%) ever filed on Samadhaan
current_solution: Phone/WhatsApp follow-ups, lawyers, MSEFC, TReDS (Rs 3.47 lakh cr FY26), credit-bureau reporting (Recordent)
current_spending: TReDS discount charges; legal/collection fees; no consolidated estimate
digital_readiness: Medium (e-invoice data exists for >Rs 5 cr firms)
competition: Low-Medium: TReDS platforms, KredX, Recordent, generic AR tools; no MSME-native AR copilot at scale
startup_opportunity: AI receivables copilot + legal escalation (ODR/MSEFC) + embedded invoice finance

who_is_affected: Micro and small firms, women-owned, traders
msmes_affected: Credit gap Rs 30 lakh cr = 24% of demand; only 41% of MSME borrowers have active formal credit
financial_impact_evidence: Gap highest for medium (29%), women-owned (35%), trading (33%) (SIDBI-Crisil 2025)
current_solution: Banks, NBFCs, fintech lenders, CGTMSE, MUDRA (Rs 5.94 lakh cr FY26), PSB digital model (Rs 52,300 cr Apr-Dec 25)
current_spending: Interest and fees on a very large loan book
competition: High: banks, NBFCs (FlexiLoans, Lendingkart, Indifi, Oxyzo), DSAs
startup_opportunity: Credit-readiness + lender marketplace; cash-flow underwriting on AA/GST

financial_impact_evidence: Profitable firms still run out of cash (73-day cycle, S22); no direct measurement
competition: Low in India; Agicap-type tools abroad
startup_opportunity: Cash-flow module inside AR/AP or banking product (not standalone)

problem: Bookkeeping and GST return preparation (owner side)
who_is_affected: All GST filers (1.49 cr normal, 13.6 lakh composition)
financial_impact_evidence: CA fees typically Rs 1-5k/month (indicative); late fees and ITC loss on errors
current_spending: Large: Tally Rs 500-1,000 cr; Clear Rs 272 cr; CA fee pool
startup_opportunity: Avoid head-on; serve via CA-firm tooling (P05)

problem: CA-firm productivity: client data collection, entry and reconciliation
who_is_affected: ~99k CA firms, 1.6 lakh practising CAs, plus non-CA tax practitioners (count unavailable)
msmes_affected: ~1 lakh firms serving most of the 1.49 crore GST filers
financial_impact_evidence: Staff shortage and manual data entry from WhatsApp photos, PDFs and bank statements; due-date crunch
current_solution: Articled staff, Excel, Tally, practice-management tools, GST software
current_spending: CAs already buy GST/ITR/Tally software (Rs 5-50k/yr typical, indicative)
competition: Medium: Clear, Suvit, Tally add-ons, practice-management tools; AI layer immature
startup_opportunity: AI copilot for CA firms: WhatsApp document intake, auto-posting to Tally, GSTR-2B/IMS reconciliation, notices
